purpose: Mechanism study: isolate whether pre-LLM prefetch removes the extra model/tool turn imposed by mandatory Borg lookup. This is not an independent solve-rate replication because it reuses the frozen v2 taskset.

conditions.T0_tool_empty: Agent must invoke the Borg tool; the isolated trace database is empty.
conditions.T1_tool_seeded: Agent must invoke the Borg tool; the isolated trace database contains the preregistered relevant trace.
conditions.P0_prefetch_empty: The harness performs retrieval before the first model call; a no-match result injects no context.
conditions.P1_prefetch_seeded: The harness performs retrieval before the first model call and injects the identical matched advisory as untrusted context.

primary_contrast: P1_prefetch_seeded minus T1_tool_seeded among pairs solved by both conditions
integrity_rules: All four conditions use the same frozen task fixtures, hidden graders, model, provider, turn budget, and Borg retrieval code.
The only seeded-arm manipulation is delivery timing: mandatory terminal tool turn versus pre-first-call context.
No-match prefetch is invisible to the model; it injects no no-match framing text beyond the same control sentence used for no prior guidance.
Every memory condition must have exactly one auditable lookup invocation or it is invalid.
Hidden graders are materialized only after the model exits; test modifications fail the run.
Crashes, timeouts, invalid runs, and turn-budget exhaustion remain in solve-rate denominators.
Provider cache-read tokens are reported separately; non_cache_tokens equals input_tokens plus output_tokens.

decision_rule.mechanism_improved_directionally: P1 has no solve-rate negative transfer versus T1 and has lower median paired API calls plus lower median paired non-cache tokens among pairs solved by both.
decision_rule.mechanism_regressed: P1 fails any task passed by T1, emits invalid treatment evidence, or has higher median paired API calls.
decision_rule.claim_boundary: Eight reused tasks can establish an engineering delivery improvement, not general Borg effectiveness. Product-value claims still require held-out powered replication and first-10 external-user outcomes.
